name: vtbl
meaning: vtable 0x574404 (one slot: BsFile_ScalarDeletingDtor 0x420420); stored by BsFile_Open 0x41b7fc and BsFile_Dtor 0x41b9bf

name: ok
meaning: 1 once the file loaded and its Vdx7 companion opened (BsFile_Open 0x41b99b copies vdx->ok); NextFrame/FirstFrame do nothing unless it is 1 (0x41ba8c)

name: frameCount
meaning: number of frame-directory entries, the u32 at file offset 0xc (BsFile_Open 0x41b8ce); NextFrame wraps the index at it (0x41babb)

name: frameType
meaning: type byte of the current frame: directory entry >> 24, with bit 0x40 masked off by Next/FirstFrame (0x41bb02); 3/4/0xb/0x26/0x27 = geometry (Bs_IsGeometryResource 0x41ba29)

name: data
meaning: base of the loaded "V2.6" Black Sheep model/anim file image

name: size
meaning: byte length of the loaded image; <= 0 aborts the load

name: cursor
meaning: read offset advanced by BsFile_ReadU16/U32 when their `advance` argument is 1

name: frameIndex
meaning: index of the current frame-directory entry; NextFrame increments it (0x41baa9), FirstFrame zeroes it (0x41bb84)

name: vdx
meaning: the companion .VDX7 reader opened from the same path with the extension replaced by DAV (BsFile_Open 0x41b98c); deleted through its vtable slot 0 by BsFile_Dtor 0x41ba0b
